relations.description: Registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS registration type IE.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode triggers registration procedure.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode leads to 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode leads to EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode with no active PDU session interworking triggers EPS attach procedure.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode with no active PDU session interworking leads to EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode with no active PDU session interworking leads to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported triggers tracking area updating procedure.
EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported leads to EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
Successful registration procedure resets registration attempt counter.
Successful registration procedure resets attach attempt counter.
